description: Saves one UNSENT draft in the company's connected mailbox (Gmail or Missive), where the founder reads it and presses send themselves. Nothing is delivered. Use it for a draft the member approved in this conversation, with the recipients they named. The service refuses a second draft to a recipient who already has an open one from Lovie; revise the stored artifact instead and tell the founder the old draft is still in their mailbox. Drafts cannot be deleted from here, so never create one to test the tool.
name: connection_create_connected_draft
title: Create Connected Draft
